turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hourly grain: its time grains are day, week, month and year, so I cannot say which hour had the most checkouts or how many there were. The closest metrics are Checkout sessions (site sessions with a checkout, on the day of the checkout) and Customer actions filtered to the checkout action type, both available by day only; I computed no figure for 20 September to 3 October 2026.
